text:
mira: Heads up — seeing big perf regression in prod-canary after merge 4623. INT8 p95 up ~60ms -> ~95ms, p99 up ~120ms. KV hit rate steady. CPU dominated by dequant path.
sahil: which commit/PR?
mira: PR #4623 (hash a1b2c3d). The change touched pacer scheduler and inflight limits + introduced a 'dequant backoff' path.
kayla: Can we pause the canary? If this is a rollout blocker let's hold.
ci-bot: perf-suite-int8 job 7821 FAILED: p95 increased beyond threshold. link: http://ci.example/7821
pranav: did a quick local bisect — points at PR 4589 (merged just before 4623). 4589 adjusted pacer pacing logic and made dequant run on hot path more often.
mira: profiler snapshot (canary host 3):
```
# top samples
int8_dequant_loop  42%
kv_cache_lookup      8%
pacer_sleep         12%
softirq             5%
copy_dequant_buf    18%
```
flamegraph shows big orange block inside decode->dequant.
sahil: interesting — before we used a deferred dequant on background thread. 4589 looks like it moved it inline for latency predictability.
kayla: notes: inline dequant avoids context switches but increases CPU on hot paths; combined with pacer config change we may be thrashing.
mira: I ran a microbenchmark: with pacer burst=32 p95=95ms, with burst=8 p95=68ms. So lower inflight reduces dequant contention.
pranav: Proposed immediate mitigation: rollback pacer changes (revert PR 4589) and reintroduce inline dequant guard that skips dequant when kv prefix cached.
kayla: +1 for revert to unblock. Can ops pause the rollout?
ops-bot: Canary rollout paused for deployment 4623 by @kayla — command: /rollout pause 4623
kayla: I'll open revert PR and mark as critical. Mira — can you attach perf trace and exact perf job links to the revert PR?
mira: will do. Adding links: perf dashboard: http://perf.example/run/3290, cpu flame: http://perf.example/flame/3290
sahil: long term we should add telemetry around dequant time per-request and a circuit that demotes inline dequant when CPU per-token > threshold.
pranav: Agreed. For now revert + follow-up patch to add guard + scheduler tunables.
kayla: Plan: 1) hold rollout, 2) open revert PR, 3) run revert on canary, 4) add guard+telemetry in follow-up. Tagging @release for visibility.
release: Acknowledged. Keep us posted.
mira: Thanks all. Starting revert PR now. /cc @sahil @pranav
